subject.title: Feature: configurable /new greeting model (or option to suppress greeting)

question: Which public reset-start policy should OpenClaw support for bare `/new` and `/reset` across chat handlers, Gateway `agent`, bootstrap-aware prompts, startup context, and model routing?
rationale: The request adds compatibility-sensitive config and model-routing surface while shipped behavior now intentionally uses cheap acknowledgements and related reports ask to restore model turns, so automation should not choose the product contract.

options.title: Define one reset-start policy
options.body: Create a single typed policy that covers ack-only, startup/model turn, prompt customization, and optional greeting-model override, then update schema, docs, and tests together.

options.title: Keep cheap acknowledgements with opt-in greeting
options.body: Preserve the shipped no-model default and expose an explicit mode for persona workflows that need a model reset greeting.

options.title: Defer new reset config
options.body: Keep current static acknowledgements and leave prompt or startup-turn customization to the existing related discussions until maintainers sponsor the contract.

recommendation.title: Define one reset-start policy
recommendation.body: Create a single typed policy that covers ack-only, startup/model turn, prompt customization, and optional greeting-model override, then update schema, docs, and tests together.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans the shipped acknowledgement branch, config compatibility, Gateway reset behavior, and prior reset-contract review history most directly tied to steipete.
